# Models and registry

`get_model(name, num_classes, in_channels, pretrained)` builds any registered architecture. The registry records which
task and family each name belongs to; the builder pages in this group document the code behind each family.

**Explained in:** [Models](../../models/index.md) · [How the registries relate](../../models/registry.md) · [Model catalogue](../../models/catalog.md)

This page documents **12 public classes and functions** in 5 modules.
